cards.text: You can perform harmless, subtle magical effects at will. For example, you can change an object's color, create a smell, light a candle, cause a tiny object to float, illuminate a room, or repair a small object.

cards.name: Strange Patterns
cards.text:
Choose a number between 1 and 12. When you roll that number on a Duality Die, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
You can change this number when you take a long rest.

cards.name: Not This Time
cards.text: Spend 3 Hope to force an adversary within Far range to reroll an attack or damage roll.

cards.name: Companion
cards.text:
You have an animal companion of your choice (at the GM's discretion). They stay by your side unless you tell them otherwise.
Take the Ranger Companion sheet. When you level up your character, choose a level-up option for your companion from this sheet as well.

cards.name: Expert Training
cards.text: Choose an additional level-up option for your companion.

cards.name: Battle-Bonded
cards.text: When an adversary attacks you while they're within your companion's Melee range, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

cards.name: Advanced Training
cards.text: Choose two additional level-up options for your companion.

cards.name: Loyal Friend
cards.text: Once per long rest, when the damage from an attack would mark your companion's last Stress or your last Hit Point and you're within Close range of each other, you or your companion can rush to the other's side and take that damage instead.

cards.name: Courage
cards.text: When you fail a roll with Fear, you gain a Hope.

cards.name: Battle Ritual
cards.text: Once per long rest, before you attempt something incredibly dangerous or face off against a foe who clearly outmatches you, describe what ritual you perform or preparations you make. When you do, clear 2 Stress and gain 2 Hope.

cards.name: Rise to the Challenge
cards.text: You are vigilant in the face of mounting danger. While you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

cards.name: Camaraderie
cards.text: Your unwavering bravery is a rallying point for your allies. You can initiate a Tag Team Roll one additional time per session. Additionally, when an ally initiates a Tag Team Roll with you, they only need to spend 2 Hope to do so.

cards.name: Slayer
cards.text: You gain a pool of dice called Slayer Dice. On a roll with Hope, you can place a d6 on this card instead of gaining a Hope, adding the die to the pool. You can store a number of Slayer Dice equal to your Proficiency. When you make an attack roll or damage roll, you can spend any number of these Slayer Dice, rolling them and adding their result to the roll. At the end of each session, clear any unspent Slayer Dice on this card and gain a Hope per die cleared.

cards.name: Weapon Specialist
cards.text: You can wield multiple weapons with dangerous ease. When you succeed on an attack, you can spend a Hope to add one of the damage dice from your secondary weapon to the damage roll. Additionally, once per long rest when you roll your Slayer Dice, reroll any 1s.

cards.name: Martial Preparation
cards.text: You're an inspirational warrior to all who travel with you. Your party gains access to the Martial Preparation downtime move. To use this move during a rest, describe how you instruct and train with your party. You and each ally who chooses this downtime move gain a d6 Slayer Die. A PC with a Slayer Die can spend it to roll the die and add the result to an attack or damage roll of their choice.

cards.name: Spirit Weapon
cards.text: When you have an equipped weapon with a range of Melee or Very Close, it can fly from your hand to attack an adversary within Close range and then return to you. You can mark a Stress to target an additional adversary within range with the same attack roll.

cards.name: Sparing Touch
cards.text: Once per long rest, touch a creature and clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress from them.

cards.name: Devout
cards.text: When you roll your Prayer Dice, you can roll an additional die and discard the lowest result. Additionally, you can use your “Sparing Touch” feature twice instead of once per long rest.

cards.name: Sacred Resonance
cards.text: When you roll damage for your “Spirit Weapon” feature, if any of the die results match, double the value of each matching die. For example, if you roll two 5s, they count as two 10s.

cards.name: Elementalist
cards.text: Choose one of the following elements at character creation: Air, Earth, Fire, Lightning, or Water. You can shape this element into harmless effects. Additionally, spend a Hope and describe how your control over this element helps an action roll you're about to make, then either gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to the roll's damage.

cards.name: Natural Evasion
cards.text: You can call forth your element to protect you from harm. When an attack roll against you succeeds, you can mark a Stress and describe how you use your element to defend you. When you do, roll a d6 and add its result to your Evasion against the attack.

cards.name: Transcendence
cards.text:
Once per long rest, you can transform into a physical manifestation of your element. When you do, describe your transformation and choose two of the following benefits to gain until your next rest:
• +4 bonus to your Severe threshold
• +1 bonus to a character trait of your choice
• +1 bonus to your Proficiency
• +2 bonus to your Evasion

cards.name: Shadow Stepper
cards.text: You can move from shadow to shadow. When you move into an area of darkness or a shadow cast by another creature or object, you can mark a Stress to disappear from where you are and reappear inside another shadow within Far range. When you reappear, you are Cloaked.

cards.name: Dark Cloud
cards.text: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, create a temporary dark cloud that covers any area within Close range. Anyone in this cloud can't see outside of it, and anyone outside of it can't see in. You're considered Cloaked from any adversary for whom the cloud blocks line of sight.

cards.name: Adrenaline
cards.text: While you're Vulnerable, add your level to your damage rolls.

cards.name: Fleeting Shadow
cards.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion. You can use your “Shadow Stepper” feature to move within Very Far range.

cards.name: Vanishing Act
cards.text: Mark a Stress to become Cloaked at any time. When Cloaked from this feature, you automatically clear the Restrained condition if you have it. You remain Cloaked in this way until you roll with Fear or until your next rest.

cards.name: Manipulate Magic
cards.text:
Your primal origin allows you to modify the essence of magic itself. After you cast a spell or make an attack using a weapon that deals magic damage, you can mark a Stress to do one of the following:
• Extend the spell or attack's reach by one range
• Gain a +2 bonus to the action roll's result
• Double a damage die of your choice
• Hit an additional target within range

cards.name: Enchanted Aid
cards.text: You can enhance the magic of others with your essence. When you Help an Ally with a Spellcast Roll, you can roll a d8 as your advantage die. Once per long rest, after an ally has made a Spellcast Roll with your help, you can swap the results of their Duality Dice.

cards.name: Arcane Charge
cards.text: You can gather magical energy to enhance your capabilities. When you take magic damage, you become Charged. Alternatively, you can spend 2 Hope to become Charged. When you successfully make an attack that deals magic damage while Charged, you can clear your Charge to either gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll or gain a +3 bonus to the Difficulty of a reaction roll the spell causes the target to make. You stop being Charged at your next long rest.

cards.name: Prepared
cards.text: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

cards.name: Adept
cards.text: When you Utilize an Experience, you can mark a Stress instead of spending a Hope. If you do, double your Experience modifier for that roll.

cards.name: Accomplished
cards.text: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

cards.name: Perfect Recall
cards.text: Once per rest, when you recall a domain card in your vault, you can reduce its Recall Cost by 1.

cards.name: Brilliant
cards.text: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

cards.name: Honed Expertise
cards.text: When you use an Experience, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, you can use it without spending Hope.

cards.name: Battlemage
cards.text: You've focused your studies on becoming an unconquerable force on the battlefield. Gain an additional Hit Point slot.

cards.name: Face Your Fear
cards.text: When you succeed with Fear on an attack roll, you deal an extra 1d10 magic damage.

cards.name: Conjure Shield
cards.text: You can maintain a protective barrier of magic. While you have at least 2 Hope, you add your Proficiency to your Evasion.

cards.name: Fueled by Fear
cards.text: The extra magic damage from your “Face Your Fear” feature increases to 2d10.

cards.name: Thrive in Chaos
cards.text: When you succeed on an attack, you can mark a Stress after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

cards.name: Have No Fear
cards.text: The extra magic damage from your “Face Your Fear” feature increases to 3d10.

cards.name: Unwavering
cards.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your damage thresholds.

cards.name: Iron Will
cards.text: When you take physical damage, you can mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity.

cards.name: Unrelenting
cards.text: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

cards.name: Partners-in-Arms
cards.text: When an ally within Very Close range takes damage, you can mark an Armor Slot to reduce the severity by one threshold.

cards.name: Undaunted
cards.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your damage thresholds.

cards.name: Loyal Protector
cards.text: When an ally within Close range has 2 or fewer Hit Points and would take damage, you can mark a Stress to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.

cards.name: Well-Connected
cards.text:
When you arrive in a prominent town or environment, you know somebody who calls this place home. Give them a name, note how you think they could be useful, and choose one fact from the following list:
• They owe me a favor, but they'll be hard to find.
• They're going to ask for something in exchange.
• They're always in a great deal of trouble.
• We used to be together. It's a long story.
• We didn't part on great terms.

cards.name: Contacts Everywhere
cards.text:
Once per session, you can briefly call on a shady contact. Choose one of the following benefits and describe what brought them here to help you in this moment:
• They provide 1 handful of gold, a unique tool, or a mundane object that the situation requires.
• On your next action roll, their help provides a +3 bonus to the result of your Hope or Fear Die.
• The next time you deal damage, they snipe from the shadows, adding 2d8 to your damage roll.

cards.name: Reliable Backup
cards.text:
You can use your “Contacts Everywhere” feature three times per session. The following options are added to the list of benefits you can choose from when you use that feature:
• When you mark 1 or more Hit Points, they can rush out to shield you, reducing the Hit Points marked by 1.
• When you make a Presence Roll in conversation, they back you up. You can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

cards.name: Gifted Performer
cards.text:
Describe how you perform for others. You can play each song once per long rest:
• Relaxing Song: You and all allies within Close range clear a Hit Point.
• Epic Song: Make a target within Close range temporarily Vulnerable.
• Heartbreaking Song: You and all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

cards.name: Maestro
cards.text: Your rallying songs steel the courage of those who listen. When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

cards.name: Virtuoso
cards.text: You are among the greatest of your craft and your skill is boundless. You can perform each of your “Gifted Performer” feature's songs twice instead of once per long rest.

cards.name: At Ease
cards.text: Gain an additional Stress slot.

cards.name: Revenge
cards.text: When an adversary within Melee range succeeds on an attack against you, you can mark 2 Stress to force the attacker to mark a Hit Point.

cards.name: Act of Reprisal
cards.text: When an adversary damages an ally within Melee range, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for the next successful attack you make against that adversary.

cards.name: Nemesis
cards.text: Spend 2 Hope to Prioritize an adversary until your next rest. When you make an attack against your Prioritized adversary, you can swap the results of your Hope and Fear Dice. You can only Prioritize one adversary at a time.

cards.name: Clarity of Nature
cards.text: Once per long rest, you can create a space of natural serenity within Close range. When you spend a few minutes resting within the space, clear Stress equal to your Instinct, distributed as you choose between you and your allies.

cards.name: Regeneration
cards.text: Touch a creature and spend 3 Hope. That creature clears 1d4 Hit Points.

cards.name: Regenerative Reach
cards.text: You can target creatures within Very Close range with your “Regeneration” feature.

cards.name: Warden's Protection
cards.text: Once per long rest, spend 2 Hope to clear 2 Hit Points on 1d4 allies within Close range.

cards.name: Defender
cards.text: Your animal transformation embodies a healing guardian spirit. When you're in Beastform and an ally within Close range marks 2 or more Hit Points, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by 1.

cards.name: Elemental Incarnation
cards.text:
Mark a Stress to Channel one of the following elements until you take Severe damage or until your next rest:
• Fire: When an adversary within Melee range deals damage to you, they take 1d10 magic damage.
• Earth: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.
• Water: When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range, all other adversaries within Very Close range must mark a Stress.
• Air: You can hover, gaining advantage on Agility Rolls.

cards.name: Elemental Aura
cards.text:
Once per rest while Channeling, you can assume an aura matching your element. The aura affects targets within Close range until your Channeling ends.
• Fire: When an adversary marks 1 or more Hit Points, they must also mark a Stress.
• Earth: Your allies gain a +1 bonus to Strength.
• Water: When an adversary deals damage to you, you can mark a Stress to move them anywhere within Very Close range of where they are.
• Air: When you or an ally takes damage from an attack beyond Melee range, reduce the damage by 1d8.

cards.name: Elemental Dominion
cards.text:
You further embody your element. While Channeling, you gain the following benefit:
• Fire: You gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for attacks and spells that deal damage.
• Earth: When you would mark Hit Points, roll a d6 per Hit Point marked. For each result of 6, reduce the number of Hit Points you mark by 1.
• Water: When an attack against you succeeds, you can mark a Stress to make the attacker temporarily Vulnerable.
• Air: You gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and can fly.

cards.name: Ruthless Predator
cards.text: When you make a damage roll, you can mark a Stress to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Additionally, when you deal Severe damage to an adversary, they must mark a Stress.

cards.name: Path Forward
cards.text: When you're traveling to a place you've previously visited or you carry an object that has been at the location before, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to your destination.

cards.name: Elusive Predator
cards.text: When your Focus makes an attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

cards.name: Apex Predator
cards.text: Before you make an attack roll against your Focus, you can spend a Hope. On a successful attack, you remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool.

cards.name: Wings of Light
cards.text:
You can fly. While flying, you can do the following:
• Mark a Stress to pick up and carry another willing creature approximately your size or smaller.
• Spend a Hope to deal an extra 1d8 damage on a successful attack.

cards.name: Ethereal Visage
cards.text: Your supernatural visage strikes awe and fear. While flying, you have advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

cards.name: Ascendant
cards.text: Gain a permanent +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

cards.name: Power of the Gods
cards.text: While flying, you deal an extra 1d12 damage instead of 1d8 from your “Wings of Light” feature.

cards.name: Rousing Speech
cards.text: Once per long rest, you can give a heartfelt, inspiring speech. All allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.

cards.name: Heart of a Poet
cards.text: After you make an action roll to impress, persuade, or offend someone, you can spend a Hope to add a d4 to the roll.

cards.name: Eloquent
cards.text:
Your moving words boost morale. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, you can do one of the following:
• Allow them to find a mundane object or tool they need.
• Help an Ally without spending Hope.
• Give them an additional downtime move during their next rest.

cards.name: Epic Poetry
cards.text: Your Rally Die increases to a d10. Additionally, when you Help an Ally, you can narrate the moment as if you were writing the tale of their heroism in a memoir. When you do, roll a d10 as your advantage die.

cards.name: Purposeful Design
cards.text: Decide who made you and for what purpose. At character creation, choose one of your Experiences that best aligns with this purpose and gain a permanent +1 bonus to it.

cards.name: Efficient
cards.text: When you take a short rest, you can choose a long rest move instead of a short rest move.

cards.name: Scales
cards.text: Your scales act as natural protection. When you would take Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

cards.name: Elemental Breath
cards.text: Choose an element for your breath (such as electricity, fire, or ice). You can use this breath against a target or group of targets within Very Close range, treating it as an Instinct weapon that deals d8 magic damage using your Proficiency.

cards.name: Thick Skin
cards.text: When you take Minor damage, you can mark 2 Stress instead of marking a Hit Point.

cards.name: Increased Fortitude
cards.text: Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage.

cards.name: Quick Reactions
cards.text: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a reaction roll.

cards.name: Celestial Trance
cards.text: During a rest, you can drop into a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

cards.name: Luckbender
cards.text: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.

cards.name: Wings
cards.text: You can fly. While flying, you can mark a Stress after an adversary makes an attack against you to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.

cards.name: Caprine Leap
cards.text: You can leap anywhere within Close range as though you were using normal movement, allowing you to vault obstacles, jump across gaps, or scale barriers with ease.

cards.name: Kick
cards.text: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to kick yourself off them, dealing an extra 2d6 damage and knocking back either yourself or the target to Very Close range.

cards.name: Charge
cards.text: When you succeed on an Agility Roll to move from Far or Very Far range into Melee range with one or more targets, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d12 physical damage to all targets within Melee range.

cards.name: Unshakable
cards.text: When you would mark a Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 6, don't mark it.

cards.name: Fungril Network
cards.text: Make an Instinct Roll (12) to use your mycelial array to speak with others of your ancestry. On a success, you can communicate across any distance.

cards.name: Death Connection
cards.text: While touching a corpse that died recently, you can mark a Stress to extract one memory from the corpse related to a specific emotion or sensation of your choice.

cards.name: Shell
cards.text: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.

cards.name: Retract
cards.text: Mark a Stress to retract into your shell. While in your shell, you have resistance to physical damage, you have disadvantage on action rolls, and you can't move.

cards.name: Endurance
cards.text: Gain an additional Hit Point slot at character creation.

cards.name: Reach
cards.text: Treat any weapon, ability, spell, or other feature that has a Melee range as though it has a Very Close range instead.

cards.name: Surefooted
cards.text: You ignore disadvantage on Agility Rolls.

cards.name: Danger Sense
cards.text: Once per rest, mark a Stress to force an adversary to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Very Close range.

cards.name: Luckbringer
cards.text: At the start of each session, everyone in your party gains a Hope.

cards.name: Internal Compass
cards.text: When you roll a 1 on your Hope Die, you can reroll it.

cards.name: High Stamina
cards.text: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

cards.name: Adaptability
cards.text: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can mark a Stress to reroll.

cards.name: Fearless
cards.text: When you roll with Fear, you can mark 2 Stress to change it into a roll with Hope instead.

cards.name: Dread Visage
cards.text: You have advantage on rolls to intimidate hostile creatures.

cards.name: Feline Instincts
cards.text: When you make an Agility Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

cards.name: Retracting Claws
cards.text: Make an Agility Roll to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily Vulnerable.

cards.name: Sturdy
cards.text: When you have 1 Hit Point remaining, attacks against you have disadvantage.

cards.name: Tusks
cards.text: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Hope to gore the target with your tusks, dealing an extra 1d6 damage.

cards.name: Amphibious
cards.text: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

cards.name: Long Tongue
cards.text: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. Mark a Stress to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals d12 physical damage using your Proficiency.

cards.name: Natural Climber
cards.text: You have advantage on Agility Rolls that involve balancing and climbing.

cards.name: Nimble
cards.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion at character creation.

cards.name: Privilege
cards.text: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation to get what you want.

cards.name: Well-Read
cards.text: You have advantage on rolls that involve the history, culture, or politics of a prominent person or place.

cards.name: Dedicated
cards.text: Record three sayings or values your upbringing instilled in you. Once per rest, when you describe how you're embodying one of these principles through your current action, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

cards.name: Steady
cards.text: You have advantage on rolls to traverse dangerous cliffs and ledges, navigate harsh environments, and use your survival knowledge.

cards.name: Know the Tide
cards.text: You can sense the ebb and flow of life. When you roll with Fear, place a token on this card. You can hold a number of tokens equal to your level. Before you make an action roll, you can spend any number of these tokens to gain a +1 bonus to the roll for each token spent. At the end of each session, clear all unspent tokens.

cards.name: Scoundrel
cards.text: You have advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

cards.name: Low-Light Living
cards.text: When you're in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

cards.name: Nomadic Pack
cards.text: Add a Nomadic Pack to your inventory. Once per session, you can spend a Hope to reach into this pack and pull out a mundane item that's useful to your situation. Work with the GM to figure out what item you take out.

cards.name: Lightfoot
cards.text: Your movement is naturally silent. You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard.

conditionDefs.name: Vulnerable
conditionDefs.text: All rolls targeting you have advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Hidden
conditionDefs.text: Any rolls against you have disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Restrained
conditionDefs.text: You can't move until this condition is cleared, but you can still take actions from your current position.

conditionDefs.name: Rooted
conditionDefs.text: Rooted in place, so that physical damage is halved.

conditionDefs.name: Smiting
conditionDefs.text: A smite is charged, and the next weapon attack that lands spends it.

conditionDefs.name: Shield Aura
conditionDefs.text: When you mark an Armor Slot, you reduce the severity of the attack by an additional threshold.

conditionDefs.name: Wise to Discord
conditionDefs.text: They have been whispered to once, and are harder to whisper to again.

conditionDefs.name: Led by Example
conditionDefs.text: The next PC to attack them can clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

conditionDefs.name: Invisible
conditionDefs.text: Not there to look at: attack rolls against you are made with disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Strategic Approach
conditionDefs.text: You have picked your line: your next attack is made with advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Strategic Approach
conditionDefs.text: You have picked your moment: a d8 goes behind the next blow that lands.

conditionDefs.name: Hardened
conditionDefs.text: One more Stress than you had.

conditionDefs.name: Toughened
conditionDefs.text: One more Hit Point than you had.

conditionDefs.name: Seasoned
conditionDefs.text: Blows land two points further up your thresholds.

conditionDefs.name: Signature Move
conditionDefs.text: The move you are known for: your next action roll throws a d20 as its Hope Die.

conditionDefs.name: Sandstormed
conditionDefs.text: Lost in blowing sand: attacks aimed at you are made with disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Force of Nature
conditionDefs.text: A hulking nature spirit: +10 to damage rolls, and a Hope for every action roll made.

conditionDefs.name: Wall of Flame
conditionDefs.text: A standing sheet of magical fire: anything that passes through it takes 4d10+3 magic damage.

effects.text: They come through the flame, and the flame notices.

conditionDefs.name: Stopped in Time
conditionDefs.text: Time is not moving for you. You can do nothing at all until it starts again.

conditionDefs.name: Timejammer
conditionDefs.text: Time is held still around you, and your next action roll lets it go.

conditionDefs.name: Immune to Magic
conditionDefs.text: Magic damage does nothing to you until your next rest.

conditionDefs.name: Echoing Strike
conditionDefs.text: The next attack you make also reaches one more target its roll would have beaten.

conditionDefs.name: Holding the Line
conditionDefs.text: A stance taken and kept: anything that comes within Very Close is dragged into reach and held there.

conditionDefs.name: Caught
conditionDefs.text: Dragged into reach of the one holding this ground.

effects.text: They come one step too close and are hauled the rest of the way in.

conditionDefs.name: Magic Circle
conditionDefs.text: Ground that answers anybody who steps onto it: 2d12+4 magic damage, and knocked back.

effects.text: The circle takes them as they cross it.

conditionDefs.name: Full Surge
conditionDefs.text: Pushed past what the body would usually allow: +2 to every action roll.

conditionDefs.name: Wild Surge
conditionDefs.text: The Wild Surge Die is active: its value is added to every action roll you make.

conditionDefs.name: Goaded
conditionDefs.text: Taunted into a swing they have not thought through: their next attack is made with disadvantage.

conditionDefs.name: Overwhelming Aura
conditionDefs.text: An adversary must mark a Stress when they target you with an attack.

conditionDefs.name: Zone of Protection
conditionDefs.text: Damage taken here is reduced by the value of the die on the card.

conditionDefs.name: In Shadow
conditionDefs.text: Attack rolls have disadvantage when targeting you.

conditionDefs.name: Shadowed
conditionDefs.text: When somebody succeeds with Hope against you here, you must mark a Stress.

effects.text: The dark closes on them.

conditionDefs.name: Life Ward
conditionDefs.text: When you would make a death move, you clear a Hit Point instead.

insteadOfDeath.says: The sigil takes it, and goes out.

conditionDefs.name: Inevitable
conditionDefs.text: Your next action roll has advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Stunned
conditionDefs.text: You can't use reactions and can't take any other actions until you clear this condition.

conditionDefs.name: Asleep
conditionDefs.text: Asleep until you take damage or the GM spends a Fear to clear it.

conditionDefs.name: On Fire
conditionDefs.text: When you act while On Fire, you take an extra 2d6 magic damage if you are still On Fire at the end of your action.

conditionDefs.name: Frenzied
conditionDefs.text: You cannot use Armor Slots, you deal ten more damage, and you are far harder to put down.

conditionDefs.name: Spectral
conditionDefs.text: You are barely here: physical damage passes through you.

conditionDefs.name: Poised
conditionDefs.text: You arrived exactly where you meant to. Your next attack is surer for it.

conditionDefs.name: Focused
conditionDefs.text: All of your attention is on one creature, and your weapon knows it.

conditionDefs.name: Inspired
conditionDefs.text: Somebody called out, and you believe them: your attacks have advantage.

conditionDefs.name: Horrified
conditionDefs.text: What you are looking at cannot be looked away from. You are Vulnerable.

conditionDefs.name: Poisoned
conditionDefs.text: Venom is working through you.

conditionDefs.name: Broken
conditionDefs.text: Something in your guard has given way, and the next blow knows where.

conditionDefs.name: Sigiled
conditionDefs.text: A sigil of retribution is on you, and it is keeping count.

conditionDefs.name: Tolled
conditionDefs.text: A toll hangs over you, and the one who set it is counting.

conditionDefs.name: Enraptured
conditionDefs.text: Your attention is fixed on the one who enraptured you, and nothing else reaches you.

conditionDefs.name: Glyphed
conditionDefs.text: A dark glyph on your body exposes your weak points.

conditionDefs.name: Entranced
conditionDefs.text: You are held by the Siren's song until you mark 2 Stress.

conditionDefs.name: Guilty
conditionDefs.text: You are Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph's god: you gain no Hope on a result with Hope.

conditionDefs.name: Chilled
conditionDefs.text: While Chilled, you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

conditionDefs.name: Tava's Armor
conditionDefs.text: +1 to your Armor Score until your next rest.

conditionDefs.name: Rogue's Dodge
conditionDefs.text: +2 to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you.

code.name: Arcane Barrage
code.notes: Spend any number of Light: one option per point held, each rolling that many d6 of magic damage.

code.name: Falling Sky
code.notes: Mark any number of Stress: one option per Stress free, each 1d20+2 magic per Stress against everything within Far.

code.name: Wild Flame
code.notes: Up to three adversaries within Melee, nearest first: 2d6 magic and a Stress on a success with Light.
